lines.l: The next time I'll be true, I'll be true, I'll be true
Footsteps on the dance floor, remind me, baby, of you
Teardrops in my eyes, next time I'll be true, yeah
Whispers in the hollow room, she cries on every tune, every tune
It's not a big baby of you
Next time I'll be true, yeah
Next time I'll be true, yeah
And the music don't feel like it did
When I felt it with you
Nothing that I do or feel
Ever feels like I felt it with you
The ARD Abend. Radio für alle.
